title: Plan option for a lancedb-enabled quipu install
description: Gap G2 from docs/design/txtai-gap-analysis.md (txtai comparison). Quipu release binaries deliberately exclude the lancedb feature, so ANN + BM25 FTS are unreachable from a caboodle-installed store and vector.backend=lancedb refuses at startup. Offer the choice as a reviewed plan line: a quipu install flavor that builds from the pinned source revision with --features lancedb (source-install adapter already exists), with version read-back and the functional round-trip proving the flavor actually compiled in (GET /version per-feature map). Acceptance: plan field defaults to the release flavor; lancedb flavor drives a source install with the feature; verify fails if /version lacks the feature; docs updated.

title: Provision checksum-pinned embedding model artifacts with an embed proof
description: Gap G6 from docs/design/txtai-gap-analysis.md (txtai comparison). txtai auto-downloads models; quipu deliberately bundles none (onnx feature ships the runtime only) and camayoc's competency scorer sits weights-less after a CDN 403. Caboodle owns the first hour, so provisioning belongs here: a plan line naming model artifacts (model.onnx, tokenizer.json, config) each with URL + sha256, fetched to a reviewed location, refused on checksum mismatch, recorded in state like every install step. Verification proves an embed-and-search round-trip with a negative control instead of trusting file presence. Acceptance: plan schema + fetch/verify with checksum refusal; state records provisioned models; round-trip proof wired into verify when quipu has onnx configured; docs updated.
